column4: I don't know. It's only us.

column5: 所以……我们应该再等等吗？
无论我们提前到达的原因是什么。

column4: I think we've been here before.
column5: 我想我们以前来过这里。

column4: I don't know why I said that.
column5: 我不知道我为什么会说出那样的话。

column4: Maybe that's what we're early for.
column5: 也许这就是我们来得早的原因。

column4: You're going to say the laptop is what we're early for.
column5: 你肯定会说我们提前到是为了买笔记本电脑。

column4: How did you know I'd say that?
column5: 你怎么知道我会这么说？
总是这样吗？我们才刚到。

column4: Maybe the laptop is what we're early for.
column5: 也许我们提前到货是为了买笔记本电脑。

column4: And it's on. Maybe we're late.
column5: 开始了。也许我们要迟到了。

column4: Why did we come in here?
You came in, so I came in.
column5: 你进来了，所以我也进来了。

column4: I came in because you did.
column5: 我进来是因为你进来了。

column4: Forget it. I'm looking at the laptop.
column5: 算了，我在看笔记本电脑。

column4: It's going to ask for a password.
How would you know? You haven't touched it.
column5: 你怎么知道？你又没碰过它。

column4: It's locked. It wants a password.
No. Not everything is about you, Gee.
column5: 不，吉，不是所有事都跟你有关。

column4: No. But it's nice you thought of me.
column5: 不，不过很高兴你能想到我。

column4: What are the odds the password is exactly what's in this room?
column5: 密码恰好就是这个房间里的东西的概率有多大？

column4: V and G are us. Who's S?
column5: V 和 G 就是我们。S 是谁？
我随便按一下按钮就行了。

column4: There's a word at the top.
That's what V-G-S stands for... You guessed it.
column5: 这就是V-G-S的含义……你猜对了。

column4: V, G, S. That's what I pressed.
You read it out. Last time.
I didn't. It just came out.
column5: 我没有刻意去做，它就这么出来了。
在“VgScript”目录下有一个名为“S1_Room.vgs”的文件。

column4: ...It's us. Everything we've said, written down.
column5: ……就是我们。我们说过的话，都写下来了。

column4: "I don't know. It's only us." "And a laptop."
column5: “我不知道。只有我们俩。”“还有一台笔记本电脑。”

column4: A bit further down there's a line of yours. Except there are three:
column5: 再往下看，你也写了一行。不过，这里有三行：

column4: "We could come back later." "I think we've been here before." "What about the laptop?"
column5: “我们可以晚点再来。”“我想我们以前来过这里。”“笔记本电脑呢？”

column4: So why are the other two there?
column5: 那么另外两个人为什么会在那里呢？
如果我说出他们的名字呢？

column4: So you get to pick, and I don't?
column5: 所以你可以选，而我没有？

column4: I didn't pick anything. I just said it.
column5: 我没选任何东西，我只是说了出来。

column4: I don't pick either. Someone else does.
column5: 我两个都不选，是别人选的。

column4: Me? I don't even get to pick mine.
column5: 我？我连选哪个都没机会。

column4: There are notes between our lines.
column5: 字里行间都蕴含着深意。

column4: So that's why I said "by a nose".
column5: 所以这就是我为什么说“险胜”的原因。

column4: It's funny. We don't even have noses.
column5: 真滑稽，我们连鼻子都没有。

column4: And right at the top: "VgScript Example scenes."
column5: 最上面写着：“VgScript 示例场景”。

column4: Too late. I saw the notes: "The player chooses what Gee says."
column5: 太迟了。我看到了备注：“玩家可以选择吉伊说的话。”

column4: And the top: "VgScript Example scenes." We're an example, Gee.
column5: 顶部写着：“VgScript 示例场景”。我们就是个例子，Gee。

column4: Of two people talking, I guess.
column5: 我猜是两个人说话的样子。

column4: Then next time, let's be funnier.
column5: 下次我们来点更有趣的吧。

column4: Don't tell me. The player's the one picking.
column5: 别告诉我。是球员自己选的。

column4: And they can start us over whenever they like.
column5: 他们随时可以重新开始。

column4: "Hi, Gee." "Hi, Vee."... It's us. Everything we've said, in a file.
column5: “嗨，Gee。”“嗨，Vee。”……是我们。我们说过的话，都记录在一个文件里。

column4: And under your name there's a list of things you could say.
column5: 你的名字下面列出了你可以说的话。

column4: I know how it ends. We start over.
column5: 我知道结局会怎样。我们重新开始。

column4: From here it goes back to the top.
Then we leave before it does.
column5: 然后我们在它之前离开。

column4: Do you think they're still there?
column5: 你觉得他们还在那里吗？

column4: Have we said all this before?
